independent_candidate_audit.data_pointers: Nine direct top AXI pointer parameters and one direct observed helper parameter. No automatic/local pointer alias/table or stored reference remains in authored top/ABI records.
independent_candidate_audit.transient_references: State/Descriptor/Counts/Ref and FullWeightDescriptor references pass pointer-free value records; memcpy takes addresses of local32-bit scalar objects. These are distinct from pointer arrays.
independent_candidate_audit.included_types: Production headers also declare FullMemory with13pointer fields, but this Q8 top instantiates no FullMemory/Controller/runtime object. Vendor ap_uint proxy implementation types are not claimed globally pointer-free; actual HLS transformation remains to verify.

approved_design_text: New isolated identity q8_joint_tm4tn8_tag_direct_v2 replaces only the two local const uint8_t* expected[4] tag-selection arrays with four sequential16-byte direct constant-array loops. At both sites the order remains model,numeric,layout,build and j0..15. Descriptor comparison still returns on first mismatch; LOAD accumulates header_ok across all64tag bytes and then performs the unchanged32-byte source-SHA check. tag_byte shift j%4 and word indices0..3 in each tag remain little endian. No source helper or pointer aggregate is introduced. Numeric operations, RAM/bank dimensions, all pragmas, ABI/ports, epochs/session/claims/error precedence and trace/counters are byte-identical outside these two hunks. Prior v1/source/config/CPU/CSim/failure remain frozen; root module design/results stay the single current document pair. Actual candidate source and all pointer-bearing automatic/global arrays and instantiated record declarations must be independently reviewed before new CPU. CPU and standard-libm CSim must be accepted for the new identity before any newly configured csynth; no RTL/OOC release.

preparation_release.before_code: Record the approved design text and frozen failure facts in current root design/results, preserving old content/history.
preparation_release.source_action: Materialize exactly the approved diff against frozen source into tag_direct_v2/source/q8_joint_tm4tn8.cpp, using expected hash above. Copy/reference unchanged ABI/top header and unchanged ACT TB/oracle/fixture. Retarget only compile input/include/output paths for new identity.

required_packet: Exact candidate source/hash/diff against frozenv1, plus inventory of every local/global pointer array and each instantiated aggregate field type.
Byte-equivalent ABI/header/TB/oracle/fixtures/model package and production headers; no new golden output.
Exact CPU build/legal/fault_load commands/configs and guard bindings; current module design/results updated.
Proposed standard-libm CSim configs and later exact csynth config with independent output identities; these remain unexecuted.

planned_separate_gates.standard_libm_csim: After CPU acceptance, legal and conditionalfault_load each16GiB/600s, actual configuration gate.
planned_separate_gates.local_csynth: After CSim acceptance, actual new config one16GiB/1800s gate.

coverage_note: Existing TB corrupts one descriptor model-tag bit; source equivalence establishes unchanged loops for allfour tags, but exhaustive per-byte corruptions are not claimed as runtime coverage.
